description: No infinite subset of the natural numbers has one cardinality-parity colour on all of its nonempty finite subsets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.cardinalParityColoring_no_infinite_constant (H : Set ℕ) (hH : H.Infinite) :
  ¬∃ i, ∀ (s : Finset ℕ), ↑s ⊆ H → s.Nonempty → Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.cardinalParityColoring s = i
